## Flux Analysis - July 15, 2026

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
# Reading in data
filtered_data <- read.csv("data/fluxes_filtered.csv")
unfiltered_data <- read.csv("data/fluxes_unfiltered.csv")

# DBH data
dbh_raw <- read_excel("data_raw/DBH and circumference measurements_up tree.xlsx", sheet="diameter & circum. up trees") |>
  select(1, 2, 4)

dbh_raw_other <- read_excel("data_raw/DBH and circumference measurements_up tree.xlsx", sheet="estimated for other trees") |>
  select(1, 2, 4)
```

## Difference between unfiltered and filtered data

```{r}
head(filtered_data)
head(unfiltered_data)
```

```{r}
# Setting up code for identifying difference in flux calculations between the two datasets
key_cols <- c("month", "year", "month_val", "tree_id", "surface") # Key variables
value_col <- "flux"                                               # Measurement of interest

diffs <- full_join(filtered_data, unfiltered_data, by = key_cols, suffix = c("_filt", "_unfilt")) |> 
  filter(is.na(.data[[paste0(value_col, "_filt")]]) != is.na(.data[[paste0(value_col, "_unfilt")]]) |
    (!is.na(.data[[paste0(value_col, "_filt")]]) & 
     !is.na(.data[[paste0(value_col, "_unfilt")]]) & 
     .data[[paste0(value_col, "_filt")]] != .data[[paste0(value_col, "_unfilt")]]))

diffs <- diffs |> 
  rename(filt_n = total_n_used) |> 
  rename(unfilt_n = total_n) |> 
  mutate(flux_diff = flux_unfilt-flux_filt) |> # Defining "difference" as Unfiltered-Filtered
  select(month, year, tree_id, surface, flag_bad, filt_n, unfilt_n, flux_filt, flux_unfilt, flux_diff)

glimpse(diffs)
```

```{r}
ggplot(diffs, aes(x = flux_filt, y = flux_unfilt, color = surface, shape=month)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "tomato") +
  labs(title = "Filtered vs. Unfiltered Flux",
       x = "Unfiltered flux", y = "Filtered flux") +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-75, 75))+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggplot(diffs, aes(x = factor(flag_bad), y = flux_diff, fill = surface)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "flag_bad", y = "Flux difference (filt - unfilt)") +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100))+ # gets rid of large outliers
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Summary stats

```

```{r}
ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x=surface, y=flux))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50))+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Getting means and sd for fluxes

flux_summary <- filtered_data |>
  group_by(date, surface) |>
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_flux   = sd(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    se_flux   = sd_flux / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Plot 1 USED

ggplot(flux_summary, aes(x = date, y = mean_flux, color = surface)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux),
    width = 5,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("soil" = "#E1BE6A", "stem" = "#668A44")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Methane Flux Over Time by Surface Type",
    subtitle = "Error bars represent ± standard error of the mean",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Mean Flux",
    color = "Surface"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Fluxes change over time

```{r}
# Including a date variable
filtered_data$date <- as.Date(paste(filtered_data$month, "1", filtered_data$year), format = "%B %d %Y")

# Creating height variable/tree_num for graphs
filtered_data <- filtered_data |> 
  mutate(
    tree_num = str_extract(tree_id, "^[0-9]{4}"),
    height   = str_extract(tree_id, "[a-zA-Z]$"),
    height   = ifelse(is.na(height), "a", height)
  )

# Factors of month (for graphing clarity later)
filtered_data <- filtered_data |>
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name))
```

```{r}
trees_only<-filtered_data |> 
  filter(surface=="stem")

soil_only<-filtered_data |> 
  filter(surface=="soil")
```

```{r}
# All trees over time
trees_only |> 
  filter(height=="a") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=flux, color=month))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Specific tree over time
tree_graph <- function(tree_number){
  trees_only |> 
    filter(tree_num == tree_number) |>
    filter(height=="a") |> 
    ggplot(aes(x=date, y=flux, color=month))+
    geom_point()+
    theme_minimal()
}

tree_graph(1606)
```

```{r}
ggplot(trees_only, aes(x=date, y=flux, color=tree_num))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(se=F)+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Patchwork graphs for all trees and months at once

trees_only <- trees_only |>
  mutate(tree_num = as.character(tree_num))

tree_list <- unique(trees_only$tree_num)

plot_list <- lapply(tree_list, function(t) {
  trees_only |>
    filter(tree_num == t) |>
    filter(height=="a") |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = date, y = flux)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste("Tree", t), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
})

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Flux over time by tree",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")))
```

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(tree_list, function(t) {
  trees_only |>
    filter(tree_num == t, height == "a") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = date, y = flux)) +
    geom_line(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    labs(title = paste("Tree", t), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7)
    )
})

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Flux over Time by Tree",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  )
```

## How do fluxes vary with height on stem?

```{r}
# Months broken out with trends in height

trees_height <- trees_only |> 
  filter(tree_num %in% c("1602", "1614", "1616")) |> # Three trees with ABCDE heights
  filter(date!="2013-05-01") |> # Only taken from A height
  mutate(tree_num = factor(tree_num, levels = c("1602", "1614", "1616")))

date_list <- sort(unique(trees_height$date))

plot_list_m <- lapply(date_list, function(d) {
  trees_height |>
    filter(date == d) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = height, y = flux, color = tree_num)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = format(d, "%B %Y"), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
})

wrap_plots(plot_list_m, ncol = 4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Extra legend is because of June 2014 - can fix but didn't prioritize this week
```

```{r}
# Height trends generally
ggplot(trees_height, aes(x= height, y= flux, color = date))+
  geom_point()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 75))+ # Removes several large outliers
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Attempt at displaying bargraph

trees_height_factor <- trees_only |> 
  filter(tree_num %in% c("1602", "1614", "1616")) |>
  filter(date!="2013-05-01") |> 
  mutate(height = factor(height, levels = c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e")), 
         date_factor = factor(date))

tree_list <- unique(trees_height_factor$tree_num)

plot_list_bar <- lapply(tree_list, function(tn) {
  trees_height_factor |>
    filter(tree_num == tn) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = date_factor, y = flux, fill = height)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge") +
    labs(title = paste("Tree", tn), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
})

wrap_plots(plot_list_bar, ncol = 1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
heights_cm <- tibble(
  height = c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e"),
  height_cm = c(45, 95, 145, 195, 345)
)

heights_cm

trees_height_factor <- trees_height_factor |> 
  left_join(heights_cm, by = "height")
```

```{r}
trees_height_fraction <- trees_height_factor |>
  filter(surface == "stem") |>
  group_by(tree_num, year, month) |>
  mutate(
    flux_a = flux[height == "a"][1],
    flux_fraction = flux / flux_a
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
ggplot(trees_height_fraction, aes(x = height_cm, y = flux_fraction, color=tree_num))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# USED , figure 3

ggplot(trees_height_fraction, aes(x = height_cm, y = flux_fraction, color = tree_num)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 5, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(45, 95, 145, 195, 345)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1602" = "#668A44", "1614" = "#7BCFD4", "1616" = "#E1BE6A")) +
  labs(
    title = "Methane Flux Reduction by Tree Height",
    subtitle = "Flux expressed as a fraction relative to the lowest measurement height (45 cm)",
    x = "Height (cm)",
    y = "Flux Fraction (relative to height A)",
    color = "Tree ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  #geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F, alpha=.5)+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
# Attempt at time series (not used)

y_range <- range(trees_height_fraction$flux_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_list_poster <- lapply(date_list, function(d) {
  trees_height_fraction |>
    filter(date == d) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = height_cm, y = flux_fraction, color = tree_num)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3) +

    scale_color_manual(values = c("1602" = "#668A44", "1614" = "#7BCFD4", "1616" = "#E1BE6A")) +
    labs(title = format(d, "%B %Y"), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7)
    )
})

wrap_plots(plot_list_poster, ncol = 4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Methane Flux Fraction by Tree Height Across Sampling Dates",
    subtitle = "Flux expressed relative to height A (45 cm); dashed line marks no reduction",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40")
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "right") &
  labs(x = "Height (cm)", y = "Flux Fraction")
```

## Are tree fluxes related to tree DBH? (at 130 cm)

```{r}
dbh_combined <- bind_rows(dbh_raw, dbh_raw_other)

dbh_clean <- dbh_combined |> 
  rename(height = `Height (cm)`) |> 
  mutate(tree_num= as.factor(Tree)) |> 
  rename(dbh = `diameter (cm)`) |> 
  filter(height == 130) |> 
  select(tree_num, dbh)

dbh_flux <- left_join(trees_only, dbh_clean, by="tree_num") |> 
  filter(height=="a")
```

```{r}
# USED, figure 2

dbh_flux <- dbh_flux |>
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month_val %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month_val %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month_val %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      month_val %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  )


ggplot(dbh_flux, aes(x = dbh, y = flux, color = season)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Winter" = "#40B0A6",
    "Fall" = "#668A44",
    "Summer" = "#E1BE6A",
    "Spring"   = "#7BCFD4"
  )) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F)+
  labs(
    title = "Flux Variation by DBH at 45 cm",
    subtitle = "Colored by season of measurement",
    x = "Diameter at Breast Height (cm)",
    y = "Flux",
    color = "Season",
    caption = "y scale manually set 0-100 to see lines clearly."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )+
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
)

```
